tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po gsang ba gnam thog me'i skor gyi gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum sogs chabs cig tu lag tu
༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po gsang ba gnam thog me'i skor gyi gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum sogs chabs cig tu lag tu

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po gsang ba gnam thog me'i skor gyi gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum sogs chabs cig tu lag tu len pa'i ṭī ka rin chen phreng ba'i gsal byed khrigs chags su bkod pa rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon rnon zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

/'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed tshe bdag nag po lcags sdig gsang ba gnam thog me'i skor gyi gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum sogs chabs cig tu lag tu len pa'i ṭī ka rin chen phreng ba'i gsal byed khrigs chags su bkod pa rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon rnon zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po dus kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes cig car du// ma lus lus med bsdoms pa'i ngo bo 'jam mgon gzhon nu rgyal ba ma lus skyed mdzad yab// gdul dka' gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad khro chen 'bar ba'i sgyu 'phrul gar gyi rnam rol che// ston mdzad dpa' bo chen po khyod la rtag par 'dud do phyag rgya grub pa'i dngos grub stsol// deng sang sa steng zil gnon gdams pa dag /lag tu len pa'i sngags ban rgyu skar ltar// grangs mang na yang gnad don ma rtogs pa'i// smyon pa'i glu gar ji bzhin spyod dus 'dir// phyag na pad dkar 'dzin pa'i rgyal ba ni// ngur smrig gar gyis rol pa'i brdzu bag gis// bdag sogs byis pa drang phyir mchog sprul pa// rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen zhabs bka' bstsal ni// dzambu nā da'i khams ltar rab lci ba// yan lag mchog gi rtse mor bkod pa'i tshe| |ldog par ma nus gnam lcags chos kyi sde// ṭī ka rin chen phreng ba'i gsal byed 'di// gtum po'i 'od snang 'di ko shar ma thag /lcags sdig dngos las 'dra ba lhag go lo// lag len gyi na sbal pa'i dbyar rnga ltar// sgrog pa mun pa'i blo can de dag kun// bag yod brten la dben par kha rog cig |'dir 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed tshe bdag nag po la bka' gter rnams su rtsa bshad man ngag gi rgyud rgyas bsdus bcu phrag gsum tsam ngos cag gi mthong byed kyis bcal ba rnams kyi bcud dang snying po bsdus pa ni gter kha so sor mang ba zhig byung 'dug kyang*/

de dag kun gyi gtso bor gyur pa tshe bdag gnubs lugs su grags pa 'di nyid yin la/ 'di la 'dra zhig so sor yod tshul bka' 'byed gser gyi lde mig nyid du/ o rgyan padmas mdzad pa'i chos tshan so brgyad/ 'khor lo nyer bdun yod pa ni lcags sdig dngos las sgrig tu med kyang thun mong gi dngos grub/ srung mtshams tsam du 'gro bar gsungs pa ni/ da lta tshe bdag pad lugs su grags pa 'di nyid yin pas lcags sdig la kha skong tsam byas kyang mi 'gal bar gsungs/ gzhan yang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ shrī singhas mdzad pa/ zla ba mngon dgas mdzad pa/ gtsang pa 'dzam gling gis brtsams pa/ bon po kun dgas brtsams pa sogs yod pa ni sdig pa'i chos 'dir sgrig tu med par gsungs shing*/ tshe bdag lcags 'dra pad lugs 'di la phyis kyi sngags 'chang mi mkhas pa la chen por rlom pa la la dag gis lcags sdig dngos las lcags sdig dang 'dra ba'i chos 'di zab cing khyad par 'phags so zhes 'chad pa dag snang mod kyi/ ji skad du/ 'dra ba'i phyir na dngos ma yin// mi 'dra ba la dpe ma grub// ces gsungs shing*/ 'jig rten 'dir yang*/ rgyal po dngos dang rgyal po 'dra ba dang*// bu dngos dang bu 'dra ba dang*/ gser dngos dang gser 'dra ba zhes tha snyad btags pa dag la dngos la 'dra ba de nyid 'phags par sems pa ni/ byis pa'am/ smyon pa'am/ myos pa'am/ 'khrul bcas shig yin na ma gtogs/ blo dang ldan pa rnams la de 'dra mi srid pa'i phyir te/ lugs gnyis ka dang dngos su 'gal ba'i yin rlom 'khrul bcas rang blo nongs pa'i rgyab sha bcad pa'i 'khyog bshad gya tshom gyi ham stobs de 'dra ba rnams ni gya ma do'i chos lugs su zad do// da ni lcags sdig dngos kyi chos sde chen po gnubs lugs su grags pa 'di nyid rang la'ang skor tsho chen po gsum du bka' 'byed nyid du gsungs te/ phyi skor lcags 'dra/

nang skor thog 'dra/ gsang ba gnam thog me'i skor zhes gsum du gsungs pa'i phyi ma gnam thog me'i skor 'di la'ang*/ ma'i skor rnams rdza lhud mo dang*/ bu'i skor rnams nyug sgrom bur sbas pa gnyis ka gter ston chen po dum pa rgya zhang khrom rdo rje 'bar gyis zab gter du bzhes pa yin la/ 'di nyid la'ang bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa gnyis las/ brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ shantiṃ garbha/ khrag 'thung nag po/ gtsug lag dpal dge/ gu hya de wa tsand+ra/ ba su dha ra/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ rgya zhang khrom/ gnubs lcags gtun nag po/ gnubs ston chos grags/ gnubs bya bral rdo rje rgyal po/ dharma ke tu/ chos kyi blo gros/ nam mkha' dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ rin chen rdo rje bdud 'joms/ rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs/ yongs 'dzin rin chen dpal/ bka' drin zla bral sangs rgyas rin chen/ de nyid kyis bdag 'bri gung pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa la bstsal ba'o// yang na sangs rgyas ye shes yan gong ltar la/ rgya zhang khrom/ rgyal ba g.yung ston pa/ bal po smon lam seng ge/ 'od zer seng ge/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ dngos grub sding pa/ rje btsun rin chen/ rin chen chos kyi blo gros phyin gong ltar ro// yang mkhas 'dod kyi sngags pa la la dag |rdo rje 'chang*/ dga' rab rdo rje/ lha'i bu tshangs pa/ nyi ma bde ba mchog ldan/ mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i 'od zer sogs 'dren pa ni/ rnying ma rgyud 'bum gyi zla gsang rtsa rgyud chen mo dregs pa tshar gcod me lce phreng ba sogs rgyud 'ga' zhig lha yul du gsungs pa'i brgyud rim dang*/ yang lcags sdig gi dpe tshan la lar bsam gtan lha yul du grags/ zhes gsungs pa gnyis gnas skabs su gung 'grigs pa ltar 'dug pas de ltar bgrang bar zad kyang*/ bka' ma'i brgyud rim gter mar 'dren dgos pa'i shes byed gang du'ang med la/

lha gnas su gsungs pa tsam rgyu mtshan du zad nas/ de'i tshe 'khor rnams brgyud rim la 'dren dgos na ni/ u rgyan gyi gnas su gsungs pa'i rgyud rnams kyi brgyud par u rgyan gyi yul de'i 'dus pa'i gtso bo rnams 'dren dgos pa sogs ha cang spros pa thal che zhing*/ ma go ba go tshul byas pa'i rang skyon char gyi rgyun ltar rang thog tu 'bebs pas soms shig /da ni brgyud pa snga ma de dag las byung ba'i gdams pa skor gsum gyi phyi ma lcags sdig nag po'i gnam thog me'i skor nyams su blang ba'i rim la gnyis/ thams cad gcig dril du nyams su blang ba dang*/ so sor nyams su blang ba'i tshul lo// dang po gcig dril du nyams su blang ba'i tshul la'ang bzhi/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor/ las kyi mtha' brtul ba rnams so// dang po bsnyen pa la'ang gnyis/ zhi bar bsnyen zhing drag po sgrub pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i rjes su gnang ba legs par mnos nas/ lcags sdig stod dril nyi ma shar ba las| byang chub sgrub pa'i chos sde byung*// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ byang chub dben pa'i gnas su 'od lnga yi ge lnga pa'i dkyil 'khor bri ba sogs rdzogs par byas la/ rang nyid 'jam dbyangs su gsal bas mtshan brjod bklag /slar 'jam dbyangs gtso 'khor drug pa'i bskyed rim dang ldan pas/ sngags tshan drug bsgril la stong phrag drug bzla bar gsungs kyang khri phrag lhag tsam bzla ba phyag len yin la/ de rjes skye med kyi yi ge'i don rnams dran pas de nyid ring ba dang thung ba so sor 'bum phrag tsam re bzla/ slar rdzogs rim gyi dmigs pa dang bcas tshe sgrub kyi sngags khri 'bum bzla/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa gtso bor bya/ las bzhi'i sham bu yang bsgyur/ yang lce byin gyis brlabs la rdo rje aye thung gi bzlas pa bya zhing*/ chos nyid 'chi kha'i 'pho ba yang sbyang*/ ā ring la bsnyen zhing a thung la bstim pa sogs man ngag gi gnad la 'byong bar bya'o// rgyab stod gnyer ma las chad pa'i sgrub thabs su/

de nas zhi sgrub tshar ba dang*/ drag po khro bo zhes gsungs pas/ gnyis pa drag po bsgrub pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon nus ldan gyi drung du/ lcags sdig khams lnga'i 'od mdangs las// dbang chog mu tig phreng ba byung*// zhes pa ltar dbang legs par thob cing dam tshig la gnas pas/ phyag rgya zil gnon gyi las gzhung bsrangs la ayai ring aye thung sku gsung thugs kyi sngags rnams bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags rnams mgo mngon re ma byung gi bar du bzla bar bya ba ni/ lha dbang du bsdu ba'i bsnyen sgrub sbrag ma yin te gnad zab par mchi'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa dngos ni/ mchin pa mchong ri smug po las/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid dang sngon 'gro// rdzas dang 'dam pa'i byin rlabs byung*// zhes gsungs pa'i bsnyen pa'i gnas ni/ lho ri gzhol ba/ byang ri skyob pa/ gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad du yod pa/ sa padma 'dab brgyad du yod pa/ shar na gtsug tor la nyi ma lta bu'i gangs yod pa/ lhor chos gos gdang la gzar ba lta bu'i nags yod pa/ nub na rma bya gdan la bzhugs pa lta bu'i brag yod pa/ byang na g.yu'i maṇḍal bkram pa lta bu'i chu yod pa/ shing rtsi sna tshogs skyes pa/ bya sna tshogs skad 'don pa/ me tog sna tshogs skyes pa/ skye bo'i ya ga ru ma song ba de lta bu'i gnas bzung ngo*// zhes gsungs pa dang mthun pa'i gnas su 'tsho ba'i zas kyi yo byad/ skom sel btung ba'i yo byad/ nad gso sman gyi yo byad/ dgra zlog mtshon cha'i yo byad dang*/ rdul phyag byed pa'i 'khor/ phyi nang brda sbyor ba'i 'khor/ g.yos byed byan po'i 'khor/ rgyas pa'i bzlas pa'i 'khor/ kar go tsa pa la sogs pa'i 'khor la sogs pa gang la gang dgos pa thams cad mchin pa nas chad pa'i chos sder gsungs pa ltar ma tshang ba med par 'du bya/ de nas thog mar rgyab stod gnyer ma gsum pa las byung ba'i sgrub thabs zhal gdams che 'bring chung gsum byung bar/

thog mar sngon 'gro lus kyi sgrib sbyang sātstsha gdab/ ngag gi sgrib sbyang 'bum sde lnga 'don/ yid kyi sgrib sbyang gtor ma gtang*/ gdams pa 'di nyid ston pa po'i bla ma la tshogs 'khor drangs/ yon phul/ de'i rjes/ lcags sdig mgo bo gru gsum la// sgrub thabs snying gzer nag po byung*// zhes par/ thog mar nus ldan brtson pa yis// sa chog dus bzang legs ldan la// zhes pa nas/ sems can gzugs kyi rgyal mtshan bkod// ces pa'i bar ji ltar gsungs pa ltar/ sa chog /rgyal tho/ khro bcu'i mtshams/ dam sri mnan pa/ sgo byang gdag pa/ ma traṃ bsgral ba rnams sngags rnying ma spyi 'gro ltar byas la/ sa chog ni dbang chog mu tig phreng bar/ rgyud las/ snang srid thams cad kyi bdag po yin zhing*/ gzhan thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir/ sa chog bya mi dgos te sa la ji ltar rung ba ltar spyad par bya'o// zhes rgyud kyi lung drangs pas sa chog ma byas kyang chog la/ de phyin gyi rgyal tho sogs ni nges par bya dgos la/ de nas mgo bo las chad pa'i sgrub thabs snying gzer nag po rang nas ji ltar bshad pa'i tshe bdag rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon la rus chen dang dur rdo bsregs pas legs par bris pa rten gyi lha grangs dang*/ phur pa/ khram shing*/ ral gri/ rgyu ma'i dra phyed sogs dang*/ phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka gtor ma sogs bag dro zhing brjid chags par bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su tshe bdag gi sku tshab tu/ re zhig mgo bo'i chos sder gsungs pa/ thod sbyor 'bru sna sman gyis bkang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar| pho mo'i thod pa mtshan ldan mchod rten gyi bum par bsham sla ba'i khyad kyis rtse thod kyi rnam par byas pa kha sbyar nang sman 'bru bkang ba/ zhing lpags dang dar nag gis dril dbus su mañdza'i khar bshams la/ de nas rang nyid tshe bdag gi nga rgyal la gnas pas/ bar gyi gnyer ma'i chos sde mngon rtogs chen mo ltar mdun gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas dang bcas pa gsal rdzogs su bskyed cing de'i phrin las ni gnyer ma'i chos sde'i bstod bskul chen mo sbyar la/

ayai ring gi bzlas pa byas pas/ rtags ni/ lcags sdig bad kan dkar po las/ phyi nang rtags kyi ngos 'dzin du: mkhar ram btsan sa zin pa dang : zhes pa nas/ de rnams dang po rtags su bshad// ces pa'i bar rtags mthong nas/ dkyil 'khor dbus kyi thod pa las dngos grub blang ba'i cho ga byas rjes/ mchod bstod bzod gsol gyi mthar thod pa'i lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa thod pa la bstim/ tshur blangs nang gi sman 'bru tshags byas la phyis rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi skyob dang 'phrod la bsre chog /de nas rgyab stod gnyer ma las chad pa'i chos sde/ pho thod mo thod bzang po la: lha bzo stobs ldan mkhas pa yis: rgyal la bzung ste yab yum sku: sras mchog sbyor sgrol mkha' lding bzhi: gsang mtshan gser dngul thugs kar bzhengs: zhes gsungs pas/ thod pa gnyis kyi nang du bum chu blugs nyi ma la lan 'ga' yar bsros pas snum dag par byas/ bul gyi tshas tshon la mi bsgrib pa'i phyir chu gtsang gis lan 'ga' yar dag par bkrus la/ skar ma rgyal la bab pa'i dus thod pa gnyis ka'i dpral ba'i phyogs su lha'i dbu bstan nas/ pho thod la yab kyi sku thugs kar lha gnyis/ khyams khang*/ spyi bor mkha' lding*/ mo thod la sbyor sgrol gyi yum gnyis gshibs te bzhengs pa bri/ de'ang mo thod la yum bri ba ni pho thod kyi yab la mo thod kha sbyor ba'i tshe mo thod kyi sgrol yum yab kyi gzhogs g.yas ngos dang*/ sbyor yum yab kyi gzhogs g.yon ngos 'ong bar byas te bri/ de dag la tshon ni zla gsang gi rgyud las/ tshon rtsi spyin med bzang po yis// dur khrod ras la dpa' bo'i gzugs// zhes gsungs pas/ tshon rnams la spyin ma yin pa'i mtshe'i khaṇḍa dang*/ baṃ gyi snying khrag dang*/ mkhris chen sogs sbyar ba'i tshon gyis lha thams cad mngon rtogs ji lta ba rgyan chas phyag mtshan sogs nor 'khrul chad lhag gtan nas med pa shin tu gal che/

bris zin nas rtsa ba'i lha drug /gyad gnon gyi lha brgyad dang bcas pa so so'i thugs kar gser ram dngul gyis rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar rang rang gi sngags rnams/ lcags sdig mgo bo las chad pa'i chos sde sgrub thabs nas ji ltar gsungs pa g.yas skor du bris pa'i sngags rnams su bdag sgrub pa po che ge mo la srung zhing rgyas par mdzod cig ces btags pa dbu can du bri/ seng ldeng ngam shug pa la rang gi bla byang dkyus sor brgyad zheng sor lnga pa la rang gzugs ci 'dra ba bris pa'i snying khar nṛ'i mthar bdag sgrub pa po che ge mo la srung zhing skyob pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ shin tu dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ zhes g.yas skor du bri/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ rgyab tu ye dharma them can dang*/ ā yuḥdang*/ su pra tiṣṭha sogs klog thabs su bri/ gzugs mthar yang rten snying bri/ de dag la gsang ba'i rdzas kyis byug /skyes pa g.yul du bsad pa'i snying ngam/ stag gzig gam/ ra rog sogs snying rul sungs ma song zhing ma nyams pa legs par bskams pa'i rtsa sbug nang du ayai ring la sngags tshan dang po gsum la 'bru gsum dang*/ mthar āḥhūm̐ dzaḥgasum btags pa dang*/ gzhan yang aye thung dang sku gsung thugs kyi sngags dang*/ bya khyung ya ma phyag rdor khyams khang sbyor sgrol dbyings yum gyad gnon brgyad dang bcas pa'i sngags rnams lcags sdig mgo bo las chad pa'i sgrub thabs su gsungs pa ltar chad lhag med pa'i mthar gong ltar sham bu btags pa dbu can du gser dngul gyis bris pa dar tshon gyis dril la bcug /'bru nag gi rjen phye khrag chen gyis sbrus pa'i zan gyis rtsa sbug bkag /gri mda' la ayai ring la sogs pa'i sngags rnams man ngag lag len ltar bris par gri khrag gis byugs shing dar nag gis dril ba dang*/ ṭī ka rin chen phreng ba'i gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum gyi 'khor lo bcu pa/

lcags sdig srog rtsa las chad pa'i bsam gtan stong srog gi 'khor lo gzhung dang dpe bris dang bstun la bris pa gong ltar tshon rtsi legs par byugs pa rnams tshogs par byas la/ thod sku zhal sbyar ba'i bar du bsam gtan stong srog gi 'khor lo lte ba ma nyams par srung lteb spyi 'gro ltar byas la/ khyad par lha'i zhal mgo zhabs ma log cing rang ngos la gzigs pa 'ong bar byas la/ yab thod ngos nas tshur zhal phyogs par bsgreng*/ bla byang 'khor lo la kha lta bar phar phyogs par byas la sbyar/ yum thod yab thod la zhal sbyor la bsgrigs/ de dag gi bar thams cad sman 'bru dri bzang rin po ches bkang ba'i phyi tshon skud gyis bcings/ zhing lpags kyis dril/ de'i phyi dar nag gis btums la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su khri'i steng du rin po che'i snod dam thod pa mtshan ldan 'brus bkang ba'i nang du yab zhal rang la phyogs par bsgreng stabs su bzhugs/ steng na dar nag gis gur phub/ gri snying mgo zhabs ma log par dar nag gi cod pan dang stag gzig gi ras mo dang bcas gri mda'i mgul du bcings la thod sku'i rgyab ngos su btsugs la bzhag /sman raka gtor ma phyi nang gsang mchod la sogs sngar ltar ma tshang ba med pa brjid chags par bshams/ lhag par khrag chen gyi arghaṃ/ dbang po lnga'i me tog /sha chen 'dre 'jigs dang sbyar ba'i bdug pa/ tshil chen zhag rkang dug gi snang gsal/ mkhris chen gyi byug pa/ 'bru nag gi bshos bu/ sha khrag rus pas sbags pa'i bshos/ rkang gling thod rnga/ khyad par zla gsang rgyud chen las| rdza rnga rdung zhing bshug pas 'bod// smug chen smug chung snying la brten// zhes gsungs pas/ rdza rnga'i rol mo/ snying sna la sogs pa khyad par gyi dam rdzas rnams tshogs par byas la/ rang nyid zil gnon gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas/ bar gyi gnyer ma'i chos sde mngon rtogs chen po dang*/ smad kyi gnyer ma las byung ba'i bstod bskul chen mo sbrag pas/

mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed cing thod sku gri snying stong srog gi 'khor lo rnams kyang bris pa ji lta ba bskyed cing*/ gri snying nang gi sngags rnams kyang lha so sor gsal btab/ bla byang rang nyid dngos su 'dra bar bsam/ lha thams cad thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar rang sngags dang*/ de'i mthar ayai ring re res g.yas su bskor zhing 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa me 'od ltar 'bar zhing 'phros pas rtsa gsum zhi khro dkon mchog gsum dang*/ chos skyong lha srin sde brgyad la sogs pa mchog dman bar ma thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas/ sgrub rdzas rnams la thim par dmigs shing*/ ayai ring 'bum phrag bdun nges par thems la smra ba bcad la bzla/ thun drug gam bzhir sman raka gtor mchod rgyas par 'bul zhing rdza rnga rkang gling bshug pa'i sgra drag po dang bcas bstod cing bskul/ de yang ji skad du/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bdun gyis 'grub// ces dang*/ ayai ring sgrub pa gang 'grub kyi: 'bum phrag bdun gyis 'grub par gsungs: ā hūm̐ btags la bzla bar bya: zhes dang*/ āḥhūm̐ dzaḥgasum btags byas la: bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bdun gyis 'grub: ces gsungs la/ bsnyen pa ma thems pa'i skyon ni/ ji skad du/ sgrub pa dngos grub ma thob na// las rnams thams cad ye mi 'grub// gshin rje mkhan po ltog par 'gyur// mthu dang nus pa 'byung mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs| de rjes lcags sdig glo ba gangs ri dkar po las chad pa'i chos sde lag len don bsdebs chen mor gsungs pa ltar/ gtsang ma lha'i bsdebs rang gi lugs su bzhugs pa ltar/ bsnyen pa dngos dang*/ dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ dam bsre dngos grub blang ba dang*/ gnyis med bstim pa dang*/ nyams grib bshags pa'i bsdebs rnams so sor sbyar ba stong phrag re re tsam dag par bzla/ slar yang lcags sdig mgo bo'i chos sde las gsungs pa ltar/

thugs kar nyi ma'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i dbyibs can sran ma'i kha tsam gyi dbus su hūm̐ la aye thung gi sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ aye a kro te ka ya mānta ka nas/ pa ye hūm̐ gi bar/ 'bum phrag tsam dang*/ de rjes la oṃ āḥhūm̐ dzaḥzhes pa khri phrag tsam dang*/ slar yang e be tā lī zhes pa nas/ ya ma rā dza hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar rtsa ba'i lha drug gyad gnon gyi lha brgyad dang bcas pa'i sngags so sor khri phrag re re/ oṃ ya ma du sha hūm̐ zhes pa sku sprul nas bzung*/ dun bhyo dun bhyo ya zhes pa za ma'i gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu'i sngags kyi bar rnams so sor stong phrag tsam re bzla dgos la/ sngags de thams cad ni lcags sdig mgo bo las chad pa'i chos sde sgrub thabs snying gzer nag po nyid du gsal bar gsungs pa nyid yin la/ slar yang chos sde de nyid las/ sgrol yum thugs ka'i dzaḥlas ni: zhes pa nas/ gzi brjid ldan par bsam gyi bar dang*/ aye ka ya ma he dun raksha dun dun dzaḥya a/ zhes sku'i sngags 'bru bcu gsum pa khri bzla/ yang de nyid las/ āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros// zhes pa nas/ ngag la nus pa bsnyen rdzogs bsam gyi bar byas la/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ zhes gsung gi sngags 'bru bcu gnyis pa khri/ yang de nyid las/ hūm̐ las 'od zer mthing kha 'phros// zhes pa nas/ chen po'i bdag por gyur ces pa'i bar dang*/ aye myag ya rngub mug shag ka dun/ zhes thugs kyi sngags 'bru brgyad pa la khri/ yang de nyid las/ trāṃ las 'od zer ser po 'phros// zhes pa nas/ yon tan yid bzhin nor ltar bsam// zhes pa'i bar gyi/ aye dun ka yaṃ/ zhes rgya gram gyi rtsa sngags 'bru bzhi pa la khri/ de nas phrin las kyi bsgrub pa ni| phur thun sgrub pa yin pas/ thod pa mtshan ngan gcig tu pho lha rang gshed dbab pa'i phyir yungs nag dang*/ zi ra nag po/ srog lha rang gshed dbab pa'i phyir ske tshe shang tshe/

ma lha rang gshed dbab pa'i phyir ra rog /khyi nag /phag nag gsum gyi khrag /zhang lha rang gshed dbab pa'i phyir zangs phye dang lcags phye/ yul lha rang gshed dbab pa'i phyir gu gul nag po sngags ma btab pa/ zhes thun rdzas 'di rnams pra khrid sgron ma rgyas pa gnam lcags 'phrul gyi lde mig las/ drag po thun gyis bsad pa'i skabs gsungs pa yin la/ gzhan yang gri thabs gtong ba la gri khrag dang*/ mtshon cha'i rtse mo dang*/ gri lcags phye ma/ rims nad gtong ba la rims kyis shi ba'i khrag /smyo bar byed pa la smyon pa'i khrag dang*/ da dhu ra dang ka mo nya/ tsha ba bskyed pa la tsha ba gsum/ 'byed par byed pa la zi ra dkar nag /mdze dbab pa la mdze khrag /hur thum gyis gsod pa la skyes bu ra skad ma/ 'thibs shing 'thom par byed pa la phung sa sna tshogs pa sogs drag po'i thun rdzas rnams mi rta khyi gsum gyi khrag rlon gyis sbrus pa blug /de'i dbus su gri lcags sam seng ldeng gi ri rab kyi phur bu sor bcu drug pa gri khrag dang dug gis byugs pa/ dar nag gi cod pan btags pa gzug /dar nag gi lding gur phub la/ mgo bo'i chos sder yon tan gyi bsnyen pa'i 'phror/ hrīḥlas 'od zer ljang gu 'phros// zhes pa nas/ drag po thun zlog nus ldan bsam// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ aye myag 'bru brgyad la sgo bzhi'i thun sngags sham bcas btags pa 'bum phrag gcig thems nges su bzla/ de ltar sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi bsnyen pa'i skabs bsam/ rgyud ni/ lcags sdig rgyab stod gnyer ma las byung ba'i chos sde'i sgrub thabs ltar rang nyid tshe bdag sku mdog dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gur bsgyur zhing*/ de dag gi thugs kar oṃ āḥhūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥrnams bkod nas sngar bshad pa'i mgo bo'i chos sder gsungs pa'i dmigs pa rnams bya zhing bshad ma thag pa'i sngags rnams bzla/ de grub nas slar dregs pa'i srog 'phrog pa'i bzlas pa bya ba ni/

lcags sdig rgyab stod gnyer ma las chad pa'i chos sde las/ de nas yab yum 'khril sbyor nas: zhes pa nas/ mo rgyud bla rdo gsang ba'i gnad: ces pa'i bar byas la/ ayai ring stong phrag gcig bzla/ de grub nas dngos grub kyi cho ga ni 'bru zan gyi tshe rgyas zur brgyad pa la dkar dmar bza' btung bca' ba sna tshogs dang bcas pa dar snas brgyan pa dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad gya nom pa bshams/ tshogs sreg gtor bkrus byin gyis brlabs/ bdag zil gnon du gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i sa bon las 'od lnga glog gi zhags pa ltar rno zhing myur ba spros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i brtan g.yo snod bcud ma lus pa'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad ma lus pa bsdus/ tshe rgyas dang tshogs rdzas la thim par bsams la/ kā ya wāka tsitta ā yurdzñā na tshe bhrūṃ nṛ dzaḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa 'di lcags sdig rgyab stod gnyer ma'i chos sder gsungs pa'i aye thung la btags pa stong phrag gcig bzla/ de rjes mgo bo las chad pa'i sgrub thabs su/ phyi snod nang bcud thams cad sems// zhes pa nas/ rang gi lus ngag yid la thim// zhes pa'i bar bsgoms la tshe rgyas kyi phud lha la phul/ bar ma dngos grub kyi rdzas su rang nyid rol/ tha ma phyis kyi sgrub rdzas la bsre ba'i phab rgyun du bzhag /gtang rag gi tshul du tshogs kyis mchod/ rang yang dngos grub tu myong*/ lhag ma btang*/ bskul dang*/ chad tho/ brtan skyong sogs las gzhung ltar byas rjes/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis lhag chad bskang*| ma 'byor na yi ge brgya pa ci mang bzla/ mdun bskyed rdul tshon gyi lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ thod sku yab yum dang stong srog gi 'khor lo'i gri snying gi lha rnams dam ye dbyer med du brtan bzhugs byas la/ rten snying them can dang su pra tiṣṭhas rab tu gnas/

shis brjod la sgrub rdzas rnams dben par gzhan gyis mi mthong bar bzhugs su gsol/ mchod rten mi bca' na stong srog 'khor lo'i gri snying bdag byang dang sbrags pa rang gi mchan khung g.yon par bcang*/ thod sku yab yum sgrub rten bya ba yin no// gsum pa las
